blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
You started with a form and a hardcoded list. And now, you end with a fully connected journal app that has:

items: Live data fetched from an API
A detail drawer for reading entries
All logic cleanly separated into composable hooks

rows: Removed the form. Fetched entries from JSONPlaceholder. Added loading, error, and empty states.
Autofocused the search input. Built a drawer that closes on outside click or Escape key.
Lifted search state. Filtered and paginated entries with derived state. Stabilised function references.
Extracted useFetch(), useSearch(), usePagination(). App composes them in a handful of lines.
